fields.Name: T201 - Database Designer Edit Entity Modify Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the alter-entity modify flow (ModifyEntityId slide-panel → database-modify tabs Fields/Review/Apply + alter preview pane) — a distinct schema-modification UI, separate from the create wizard and generic forms.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the Database Designer. Wait for the entity table to load (10-30s possible — wait, don't navigate away). Each entity row has an 'Edit' button (pen icon) in its Actions column. Click Edit on any row. Success is that an 'Edit Entity' slide-over panel opens showing the entity's name and schema.table path, a tab bar with 'Fields', 'Review Changes', and 'Apply Changes' tabs, the Fields grid on the left, and a live preview pane on the right. Switch to the 'Review Changes' tab to confirm the tabs work. Seeing the modify panel with its tabs render is success — do NOT actually apply any schema changes. You may close/cancel afterward.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking Edit on an entity row opens an 'Edit Entity' slide-over showing the entity name and schema.table path
The panel shows Fields / Review Changes / Apply Changes tabs with a fields grid and preview pane, and switching tabs updates the content
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
